mainText: Good morning. Here's your market briefing for Tuesday, October 20. Index futures are mixed ahead of the open. Dow futures up about a quarter of a percent, or 115 points. S and P futures roughly flat, down a tenth of a percent. Nasdaq futures down about half a percent, dragged down by renewed weakness in AI-linked stocks. South Korea's market tumbled 4 percent overnight, and Brent crude is up nearly 2 percent to about 111 dollars a barrel, near a five-month high, on attacks on Saudi infrastructure. The 10-year Treasury yield is about 5.11 percent, down slightly as investors buy safe havens. Premarket movers: Garmin down nearly 8 percent, CoreWeave down about 3 percent, and chip stocks are weak, with Micron down 2 and a half percent. Earnings in focus: G M, United Airlines, 3 M, and Hasbro before the open, Netflix after the close.
